content: A wise wanderer keeps watchful eyes and silent ears wherever his footsteps take him.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: Gáttir allar, áðr gangi fram (Hávamál, Stanza 1) — Poetic Edda
explanation: When stepping into unfamiliar halls or new ventures, the fool immediately starts chattering, declaring his opinions, and announcing his resume. The wise traveler enters quietly, observes the exits, studies the room, and listens deeply before speaking a single word.
practicalInsight: Enter your next meeting or gathering today with watchful eyes and silent ears. Observe the unspoken dynamics first.
reflectionPrompt: Do you rush to speak and make an impression in new environments before taking time to understand the territory?
